text: You are a 22-year-old male with a two-day history of fever and altered mental status. speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever and altered mentation. I also have Profuse sweating, Generalized rigidity, Confusion and disorientation, Ability to move all limbs, Normal deep tendon reflexes with bilateral downgoing plantar responses.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome (NMS). The combination of fever, altered mentation, profuse sweating, and generalized rigidity in a patient taking haloperidol is highly specific for NMS.
